summary.intent: Run the GSD manager command center to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42 API unpin integrity, 43 FUSE write durability, 44 IPNS conflict handling) from a UAT audit against the CipherBox v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 fully closed (8 plans, 3 waves, code review, verification, todos archived). Phase 43 executed through wave 5 of 6 gap-closure plans (7/8 plans complete); wave 6 merge and re-verify pending. Phase 44 discussed and context written but not yet planned or executed.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) had no ownership check — handler never read req.user, passing any JWT-supplied CID directly to Kubo pin/rm, making cross-tenant data destruction trivially possible with a harvested CID.

Kubo runs with the 'server' profile (docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) with swarm port 4001 publicly exposed; server profile only disables LAN discovery, not DHT — pinned CIDs are broadcast as provider records to DHT crawlers.

Writable-share saves drop prunedCids (shared-write.ts:450) without unpinning — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists in the codebase, confirming the unpin endpoint's lack of ownership check is a pure attack surface.
BYO-IPFS unpin path was broken in both directions; the new guardedUnpin semantics handle it correctly for free since 'not pinned' is swallowed by the outbox.
.prettierignore was absent entirely — prettier was mangling all .planning/ and .claude/ GSD-controlled markdown on every pre-commit run.

pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X is broken: pnpm inserts a '--' separator, making jest treat the pattern flag as a positional regex; must use pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X' instead.
WinFsp cross-compilation (--features winfsp) fails on macOS due to pre-existing issues in windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates; cargo check on cipherbox project crates still passes cleanly.
GSD commit helper (gsd_run query commit) returns 'committed: false' as a false negative while the commit actually lands — always verify with git log, never blind-retry.
cleanup-wave must be invoked from the repo root; running it with cwd inside an agent worktree produces a false base_mismatch error because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.
Phase branches (feat/api-unpin-integrity, feat/fuse-write-durability, feat/ipns-conflict-handling) are auto-managed by GSD; main remains untouched throughout.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID without ownership check — can unpin a content-addressed blob shared with another user's file.

guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete + refcount → pending_unpins outbox insert (all in one transaction) → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort; cross-user attempts emit silent 2XX + audit metric.
Kubo v0.40 configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp); server profile keeps full public DHT participation, so all pinned CIDs are broadcast as provider records.
fetchQuota() reconcile call added after removeUsage() — quota store was previously left stale after client-side delete (plan 42-02 TDD fix).

Full rewrite in phase 43-01: JournalOp enum, JournalEntry with fsync-before-ack, WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay — replaces the previous non-durable in-memory queue.

handle_release ordering enforced: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943); ensures journal entry survives any crash between ack and upload completion.
handle_mkdir: journal.put(534) inside closure before reply.entry(655); conflict arm sends FsEvent::MkdirConflict instead of warn-only; journal entry cleared only on parent-publish success.

BullMQ WorkerHost with drainPendingUnpins (calls provider, not raw Kubo; error-isolates per row; publishes gauge) and runDriftReport (NDJSON parse, read-only — zero .delete( calls in drift path to prevent accidental GC).

workflow: cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun; write reduced manifests containing only remaining unmerged entries for any rerun attempt.
Worktree merges silently fail or partially complete when agent worktrees contain untracked node_modules or .husky/_ dirs — remove these before invoking cleanup-wave.
A git merge that auto-resolves all conflicts but fails at the commit step leaves MERGE_HEAD; conclude with git commit --no-edit rather than aborting.
nest build (or api:generate) produces formatting-only changes to openapi.json in the main tree as a side-effect; restore with git checkout -- before worktree merges to prevent false conflicts.
GSD plan decision coverage gate requires literal citation strings (e.g. 'D-07:') in plan must_haves sections — grep-based gate fails silently if citations use different formatting.
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git commit Bash calls; signing failures ('agent returned an error') require restarting the 1Password desktop app.
RAM constraint: subagents must never run full monorepo test suites; always use targeted --filter + --testPathPattern patterns to avoid OOM in worker processes.
The GSD verifier produces a VERIFICATION.md with gaps_found status when human-verify checkpoints are present; a gap-closure planning round is triggered automatically, adding plans 05+ to the phase.

friction: Session quota limits hit twice mid-execution, interrupting active background agents and requiring manual recovery and re-dispatch of wave executors.
Accidental user input ('touring wyatt web bossy') interrupted execution flow twice, requiring explicit resume prompts.
1Password SSH signing failures required user to manually restart the 1Password desktop app before commits could proceed.
gsd commit helper false negatives ('committed: false') triggered unnecessary retry attempts and git log verification on every commit.
Planner agent socket error mid-planning (after writing plans 01-03) required filesystem inspection and spawning a continuation planner for plans 04-08.
cleanup-wave cwd bug caused false base_mismatch errors when invoked from inside a worktree, requiring re-runs from repo root.
cleanup-wave non-idempotency required manually constructing reduced manifest JSON files for each re-run after partial completions.
zsh multi-glob rm (rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules) aborts entirely if any glob misses — required splitting into individual rm calls.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD after auto-resolving all conflicts but failing at commit; required git commit --no-edit to conclude.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effects in main tree had to be manually restored before each wave merge.
prettier was mangling planning docs on pre-commit (missing .prettierignore) and also broke a regex pipe in VALIDATION.md into a table column, requiring a manual edit fix.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failure required adding a literal citation line to 42-03-PLAN.md must_haves after gates were already considered passing.
